  <text_text>把函数想象成一台「自动售货机」：你只能投进它认可的硬币（合法输入），投错币机器就不工作。定义域就是这台机器**允许你投进去的所有输入值的集合**。</text_text>
</textCenterCard>

name: 定义域产物 · textCenterCard 核心定义
description: 实际产物单卡（函数定义域讲义，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<textCenterCard>
  <text_title>核心定义</text_title>
  <text_text>函数 $f$ 的定义域，是使函数表达式**有意义**的所有自变量 $x$ 的取值集合，记作 $D_f$ 或 $\text{Dom}(f)$。</text_text>
  <text_subtitle>label:定义域, href:https://example.com/glossary/domain</text_subtitle>
</textCenterCard>

name: 定义域产物 · textCard 直观理解
description: 实际产物单卡（函数定义域讲义，通栏）
psuip:
<textCard>
  <text_title>直观理解</text_title>
  <text_text>求定义域，本质是「排除让式子无意义的 $x$」，常见三条约束：</text_text>
  <text_subtitle>
**分母不为零**：$f(x)=\dfrac{1}{x-2}$，需 $x-2 \neq 0$，即 $x \neq 2$。
**偶次根号下非负**：$f(x)=\sqrt{x+1}$，需 $x+1 \geq 0$，即 $x \geq -1$。
**对数真数为正**：$f(x)=\log_2(x-3)$，需 $x-3 > 0$，即 $x > 3$。
  </text_subtitle>
  <text_text>综合示例：$f(x)=\dfrac{\sqrt{x+1}}{x-2}$ 的定义域为 $x \geq -1$ 且 $x \neq 2$，写作 $[-1,2)\cup(2,+\infty)$。</text_text>
</textCard>

name: 定义域产物 · commonStyleList 易错提醒
description: 实际产物单卡（函数定义域讲义，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<commonStyleList>
  <layout:column>
    <description>易错提醒</description>
    <content>**关键要点**</content>
    <title>
    求定义域时**先看整体结构**，把「分母、偶次根、对数」三类约束**同时**列出，再取交集，不要只盯着一处。
    对数真数要求**严格大于 0**（不能等于 0），而偶次根号下允许**等于 0**，两者别混淆。
    结果要用**集合或区间**表示，不能只写一个孤立的不等式就结束。
    </title>
  </layout:column>
</commonStyleList>

name: 定义域产物 · commonStyleList 易混辨析
description: 实际产物单卡（函数定义域讲义，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<commonStyleList>
  <layout:column>
    <description>易混辨析</description>
    <content>**关键要点**</content>
    <title>
    **定义域 vs 值域**：定义域是「允许输入的 $x$」，值域是「可能输出的 $y$」。前者由表达式约束决定，后者由函数映射结果决定。
    **定义域 vs 自然定义域**：自然定义域指仅由表达式本身决定的定义域；若题目额外规定范围（如「$x>0$」），则取两者交集。
    **根号 $\sqrt{x}$ 与 $\sqrt[3]{x}$**：偶次根号要求被开方数非负，奇次根号（立方根）对任意实数都有意义，无限制。
    </title>
  </layout:column>
</commonStyleList>

name: 定义域产物 · textCard 典型例题
description: 实际产物单卡（函数定义域讲义，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<textCard>
  <text_title>典型例题</text_title>
  <text_text>**题目**：求函数 $f(x)=\dfrac{\sqrt{4-x^2}}{x-1}$ 的定义域。</text_text>
  <text_subtitle>**解题过程**：</text_subtitle>
  <text_text>
偶次根号约束：$4-x^2 \geq 0$，即 $x^2 \leq 4$，得 $-2 \leq x \leq 2$。
分母约束：$x-1 \neq 0$，即 $x \neq 1$。
取交集：$[-2,2]$ 中挖去 $x=1$，得 $[-2,1)\cup(1,2]$。
  </text_text>
</textCard>

description: 实际产物单卡（函数定义域讲义，原并排于 layout:row）

<textCard>
  <text_title>记忆技巧</text_title>
  <text_text>**助记口诀**：「分母不为零，偶根要非负，对数真数正，三关全过才算数。」</text_text>
  <text_subtitle>**记忆方法**：把三类约束想象成三道「安检门」，$x$ 必须**同时**通过所有门才能进入定义域；漏掉任何一道门，答案就会多算或漏算。</text_subtitle>
</textCard>

description: 实际产物单卡（函数定义域讲义，通栏）

  <layout:column>
    <description>相关概念</description>
    <content>**关键要点**</content>
    <title>
    **值域（Range）**：函数所有可能输出值的集合，与定义域一一对应。
    **复合函数定义域**：$f(g(x))$ 的定义域，需同时满足 $g(x)$ 自身有意义，且 $g(x)$ 落在 $f$ 的定义域内。
    **区间表示法**：开区间 $(a,b)$、闭区间 $[a,b]$、半开区间及并集 $\cup$ 的书写规范。
    </title>
  </layout:column>
</commonStyleList>

name: 定积分产物 · textCard 课堂纪要
description: 实际产物单卡（定积分课堂，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<textCard>
  <text_title>Transcript Summary</text_title>
  <text_text>Lecture transcript has been organized.</text_text>
  <text_subtitle>The lecture introduced the definite integral through the problem of finding the area under a curve. The core method — partition, approximation, summation, and taking the limit — was established. The formal definition was given via Riemann sums: if the limit of Σ f(ξᵢ)Δxᵢ exists as the maximum subinterval length λ→0, independent of partition and choice of ξᵢ, then f is integrable on [a,b]. Geometric interpretation: the definite integral represents the signed area of a curvilinear trapezoid. Key properties covered include linearity, interval additivity, and sign preservation.</text_subtitle>
</textCard>

name: 定积分产物 · textCard 核心概念回顾
description: 实际产物单卡（定积分课堂，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<textCard>
  <text_title>Core Concept Review</text_title>
  <text_text>**The Definite Integral**</text_text>
  <text_subtitle>Think of it as a "signed area calculator" — it measures the net area between a curve and the x-axis, where regions above count positive and below count negative.</text_subtitle>
  <text_text>**The definite integral ∫ₐᵇ f(x)dx is the limit of Riemann sums Σ f(ξᵢ)Δxᵢ as max Δxᵢ → 0, provided this limit exists and is independent of partition and sample point choices.**</text_text>
</textCard>

name: 定积分产物 · textCenterCard 可积条件
description: 实际产物单卡（定积分课堂，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<textCenterCard>
  <text_title>**Integrability Conditions**</text_title>
  <text_text>Not every function can be integrated — the function must be "well-behaved" enough for the Riemann sum limit to exist uniquely.</text_text>
  <text_subtitle>**Continuous functions, monotonic functions, and bounded functions with finitely many discontinuities on [a,b] are all integrable. The Dirichlet function is a classic counterexample of a non-integrable function.**</text_subtitle>
</textCenterCard>

name: 定积分产物 · textCenterCard 关键性质
description: 实际产物单卡（定积分课堂，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<textCenterCard>
  <text_title>**Key Properties**</text_title>
  <text_text>Linearity: ∫(f+g) = ∫f + ∫g. Interval additivity: ∫ₐᵇ f + ∫ᵇᶜ f = ∫ₐᶜ f. Sign preservation: if f ≥ 0 on [a,b], then ∫ₐᵇ f ≥ 0.</text_text>
</textCenterCard>

name: 定积分产物 · textCenterCard 讲义原文
description: 实际产物单卡（定积分课堂，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<textCenterCard>
  <text_title>Lecture Transcript</text_title>
  <text_text>The lecture began with the problem of computing the area of a curvilinear trapezoid. Traditional area formulas for rectilinear shapes fail under curved boundaries, motivating the "approximate curves with straight lines" approach. The four-step method — partition, approximate, sum, take the limit — forms the logical core of the definite integral definition.</text_text>
</textCenterCard>

name: 定积分产物 · textCenterCard 课堂要点
description: 实际产物单卡（定积分课堂，原并排于 layout:row）
psuip:
<textCenterCard>
  <text_title>Lecture Key Points</text_title>
  <text_text>The formal definition requires that the Riemann sum limit exists regardless of how the interval is partitioned or how sample points are chosen within each subinterval. This "arbitrariness" condition is critical; without it, functions like the Dirichlet function could yield different limits under different partitions. The integral variable is a dummy variable — replacing x with any other letter does not change the value.</text_text>
</textCenterCard>

name: 定积分产物 · [table:commonStyle] 课堂要点表

psuip: [table:commonStyle] Lecture Key Points Three examples were worked through: computing ∫₀¹ x dx using equal partitions and right endpoints (result: 1/2); evaluating ∫₋₁¹ |x| dx by splitting at x=0 (result: 1); and comparing ∫₀¹ x² dx vs ∫₀¹ x dx using sign preservation. The professor repeatedly emphasized the essential distinction between definite integrals (constants) and indefinite integrals (families of functions).
